viewing_check: Check the back and edges for a maker stamp (e.g. Bruck, Wunderlich, Mills, Stoneware), pinholes, and whether the enamel is true vitreous (heavy, glassy chips) versus a reproduction. Check for any hairline cracks or restoration to the face and photograph the lower letters where chipping reaches the lettering.
